summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Harbor AlphaEdge Small Cap Value ETF (AESL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital growth through a concentrated portfolio of US small-cap value companies. The fund employs a proprietary value-factor analysis to select 75 to 200 stocks. AESL was launched on Aug 26, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.

holdings.infoBox: AESL is an equity ETF with a total of 103 individual holdings. The top holdings are United Bankshares stock at 3.43%, Apple Hospitality REIT at 3.21%, Ennis at 3.19%, First BanCorp. at 3.16%, and Home BancShares at 3.16%.
